metadata.name: Arbitrum
metadata.notes: Public directory application; no route or deployment is active without independent safety verification.

profile.name: Arbitrum
profile.shortDescription: ARB is the governance token of the Arbitrum DAO, enabling community participation in the governance of the Arbitrum ecosystem.
profile.description:
Arbitrum is an Ethereum scaling ecosystem designed to support efficient and lower-cost blockchain transactions. ARB serves as the governance token of the Arbitrum DAO, allowing token holders to participate in decentralized governance.

This XITA application is submitted independently by a token holder to propose additional cross-chain accessibility and visibility for ARB. It does not represent an official application or endorsement by the Arbitrum Foundation or DAO.

metadata.name: XGR
metadata.notes: Canonical native XGR on XGRChain. Synthetic representations on spokes use authenticated mint/burn.

profile.name: XGR
profile.shortDescription: Native asset of XGRChain and the XETA EVM interchain hub.
profile.description: XGR is the native asset of XGRChain, an EVM-compatible blockchain. XITA (XGR Interchain Token Alliance) supports permissionless route registration between XGRChain and supported EVM networks. A route is publicly usable only after verified source and destination deployments and authenticated message delivery; validators attest messages, not route admission.
